character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a full-body 64-bit-style pixel-art video game character sprite with a transparent background.

The character is a confident anime-inspired young man with spiky icy-white/silver hair, pale skin, a slight confident smirk, and bright glowing red eyes. A sleek black visor/blindfold is angled across his eyes, and he is lifting one edge of it with his right hand so one glowing red eye is clearly visible.

He wears a futuristic cybernetic shark suit built entirely around a red, black, and electric-blue color palette. Avoid white or silver clothing panels; white should primarily appear in his hair and the shark's teeth.

Shark hood
The oversized hood is shaped like the head and open mouth of a mechanical shark. The shark head faces forward around the character's head, with a large upper jaw, rows of sharp triangular teeth surrounding his face, a dorsal fin, side fins, and glowing red mechanical shark eyes. The shark exterior is predominantly black with vivid electric-blue armor edges and bright red glowing details.

Outfit
Give him an oversized futuristic black streetwear jacket/hoodie integrated into the shark armor. The clothing should have:

Black as the dominant color
Electric-blue armor plates and trim
Bright red glowing lines and accents
Shark-fin-shaped armor pieces along the shoulders, arms, hips, and legs
Loose black tactical/cargo pants
Futuristic belts, buckles, straps, chains, and small geometric armor pieces
A large mechanical shark tail extending behind him
No large white section on the chest or jacket
His left hand rests casually inside a pocket while his right hand lifts his visor. His stance should feel relaxed, powerful, and confident.

Shoes
Give him chunky Jordan 4 Retro–inspired high-top sneakers. The shoes are predominantly black and red with electric-blue accent details, recognizable by the chunky layered panels, mesh sections, lace wings, thick midsoles, and retro basketball-shoe silhouette.

Art style
Render the entire character as a 64-bit-e
